channel.title: Comments on: Poor Thais And Rich Swedes
channel.description: taoism, taoist thought, buddha, yoga, tai chi, shakuhachi

item.title: By: carl
item.dc:creator: carl
item.content:encoded:
Yes, appreciation is illusive. Naturally so, (I suppose) for otherwise one would not ‘hunt & gather’ as earnestly. Nuts!

Speaking of “Love, Frugality, & Humility”, reminds me of…

I have three treasures
Which I hold and cherish.
The first is known as compassion,
The second is known as frugality,
The third is known as not daring to take the lead in the empire;

item.title: By: brian alford
item.dc:creator: brian alford
item.description: Very well put! I also have lived with peasants for many years in the mountains of the Philippines & how I wish I could tell them just how rich they really are! The real treasures:Love,Frugality & Humility!
